Machine learning fits models to data so they can make predictions or choose actions on new inputs.
In the usual taxonomy, $\mathrm{DL} \subset \mathrm{ML} \subset \mathrm{AI}$: deep learning is part of machine learning, which is part of artificial intelligence. See Deep Learning, chapter 1.
AGI concerns the breadth of tasks a system can perform. It describes a capability goal; machine learning describes an approach to building systems. See 2311.02462⁠ (Morris et al., 2025) .
